title: TTRPG battle mode with AI
author: imalyshe
selftext: I used StageWhisper.ai, a site with advanced roleplay and GM tools: stage and scene control, plus smart search across lore, memories, characters, and locations. It is more than a simple roleplay app. It works as a framework you can build on and customize. You can add hooks at every stage of narrative generation, embed or adjust data, or take over the process with your own JavaScript. The platform also exposes APIs for talking to the LLM and for creating, editing, and reading campaign files. I used it to build a battle mode for my roleplay game.
